svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.18k stars in total, about 1.07k a year earlier, mostly from tools launched since then. mr boxington 438, aube 2025, fnox 2214, hk 1228, pitchfork 674, usage 1049, +5 more 547.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
